text: Hello, I'm here with you. Let's take one small step together. A little focus, a little rest. You're doing well.
description: An original tiny animated tuxedo-kitten companion voice. A small bright high masculine cartoon voice, springy rounded vowels, lightly nasal kitten-like sweetness and soft cheeky comic timing. Short nimble syllables with a playful upward curl, friendly and cuddly. Clear spoken words with a plush little vocal texture. Avoid ordinary adult tenor, heavy chest resonance, gruffness, meowing over words, shrill shouting or singing.
